partnershipPlan: Two residents review the prompt wording before cycle 1 and the report template before cycle 3; one faculty member from each division joins the cycle review at faculty meetings.
socialListening: No social media listening; free-text answers from the program's annual resident evaluation are read for mentions of written feedback.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: Every form says great job; I stopped reading them in first year.
items.implication: Measure comments with a next step, not the number of comments.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: I fill these in on Sunday night for the whole rotation, so of course they are vague.
items.implication: Track days to completion and encourage same-day forms.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: We cannot defend a progress decision on comments like keep reading.
items.implication: Share the run chart with the committee each quarter.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: My male co-residents get told how to manage the patient; I get told I am lovely to work with.
items.implication: Keep the monthly gender breakdown visible at faculty meetings.

summary: Four composite voices on generic praise, time pressure, committee needs and gendered feedback.
